Binary .doc fixtures are from Apache POI test-data/document, downloaded through https://api.github.com/repos/apache/poi/contents/test-data/document. Source: https://github.com/apache/poi/tree/trunk/test-data/document . Licensed under Apache-2.0; see APACHE-LICENSE.txt.

The small mixed.docx and three PDFs are project-generated minimal OOXML/PDF fixtures. mixed.docx includes a table, Unicode and an external relationship that must not be fetched; chinese.pdf uses a standard CJK CID font without embedded fonts to exercise local CMap loading.
